name: ECA Message
description: Plug-and-play bridge that swaps the Message entity's access handler so ECA models can create Message entities via ECA's generic entity actions.
project_description:
Plug & Play solution to make it possible to create message entities with the ECA module.

 Features 
 Temporary solution till https://www.drupal.org/project/eca/issues/3375899 is resolved.

 A brief documentation of how to use Message with ECA can be found here https://www.drupal.org/project/eca_message/issues/3458495 Thx to DamienMcKenna 

 Additional Requirements 
 
 ECA: Event - Condition - Action
